available_results_at_declaration: discovery seeds 0 and 1 only; no confirmation seed evaluated
purpose: secondary independent confirmation of scientifically relevant uncertainty miscalibration
candidate_groups: the six complete physical families, excluding exact boundary atoms only for nominal-quantile interpretation
boundary_atom_rule: evaluate nominal interval coverage on rows with 1e-12 < true_low_mass < 1-1e-12; report all-case coverage and excluded counts separately
selection: using discovery seeds 0-3 only, select the eligible family with smallest observed 80-percent coverage, minimum 16 eligible discovery rows
confirmation: apply the same family and atom rule to all independent seeds 4-7; no confirmation outcomes influence selection
strong_confirmation_criterion: upper endpoint of confirmation Wilson 95-percent coverage interval is below 0.8
interpretation: this is a diagnostic of the existing proper quantile predictions, not a new passing condition or a threshold change; atoms at zero naturally prevent naive quantile-CDF equality
